fn move_tokens(deps:DepsMut,from:&str,to:&str,amount:Uint128)->Result<Response,ContractError>{let to=deps.api.addr_validate(to)?;let c=CONFIG.load(deps.storage)?;let x=BALANCES.may_load(deps.storage,from)?.unwrap_or_default();if x<amount{return Err(ContractError::InsufficientFunds)};let fee=amount.multiply_ratio(c.fee_bps as u128,10_000u128);let net=amount.checked_sub(fee).map_err(StdError::overflow)?;BALANCES.save(deps.storage,from,&x.checked_sub(amount).map_err(StdError::overflow)?)?;credit(deps.storage,to.as_str(),net)?;credit(deps.storage,c.fee_collector.as_str(),fee)?;Ok(Response::new())}
